meta.name: hugging-science
meta.description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并使用科学领域的AI模型与数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做生物、化学、物理等科学领域的AI/ML工作
copy.tagline_en: Discover and use AI models and datasets for scientific domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing AI/ML work in biology, chemistry, physics, or other scientific fields

howto.what: 当你在科学领域（如生物学、化学、物理学等）使用AI/ML时，Claude会从Hugging Science的精选目录中查找科学数据集、模型、博客和交互式演示，并指导你使用标准Hugging Face工具加载和运行它们。
howto.when: 当你提出涉及AI/ML应用于科学的问题时触发，例如询问某个科学领域的数据集或模型，或需要微调科学数据、复现科学ML论文。

say.text: 帮我找一个蛋白质语言模型，比如ESM2。
say.note: Claude会从目录中推荐并指导使用。

say.text: 有没有用于药物发现的化学数据集？
say.note: Claude会搜索相关领域并给出资源。

howto.what_en: When you work on AI/ML in scientific domains (biology, chemistry, physics, etc.), Claude will search the curated Hugging Science catalog for scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive demos, and guide you to load and use them via standard Hugging Face tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about AI/ML applied to science, such as requesting a dataset or model for a scientific domain, or needing to fine-tune on scientific data or reproduce a scientific ML paper.

say_en.text: Find me a protein language model like ESM2.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend from the catalog and guide usage.

say_en.text: Is there a chemistry dataset for drug discovery?
say_en.note: Claude will search the relevant domain and provide resources.
